name: HeadTotal
why: Total IT employment across every employer and both regions

name: VendorHead
why: Staff of the three vendor types together

name: Head_{employer}
why: Who employs IT staff: clients' in-house teams, their captive centres (GCCs) and each vendor type

name: WorkShare_{employer}
why: Each employer's share of all IT work; the GCC share shows the shift from vendors to GCCs

name: OnshoreTotal
why: IT headcount onshore, visa holders included

name: IndiaTotal
why: IT headcount in India: with OnshoreTotal, the onshore and offshore mix

name: Margin_{vendor}
why: Each vendor type's margin, the signal behind its viability and distress

name: AvgIdx_{vendor}
why: The price index of each vendor type's in-force contract book: how far prices fall

name: EffortShare_revenue_weighted
why: The effort-billed share of vendor contract books: the shift away from billing by effort

name: Unemp_{region}
why: The IT unemployment rate in each regional labour pool

name: JuniorHiringRatio
why: Junior hiring relative to 2024: the entry pipeline into IT

name: A_mean
why: The share of delivery work done with AI

name: AC_mean
why: The share of clients' own consumers using AI

name: Demand
why: Total IT work that clients demand a year

name: Budget
why: Clients' total IT budget, a cap on committed spend: above it, new work is approved less often

name: Committed
why: Clients' committed IT spend: services plus software seats, AI credits and cloud

name: ServicesSpend
why: Clients' spend on IT services (in-house and GCC labour, vendor fees); with seats, AI credits and cloud it makes up Committed, and the rest of Budget is headroom the model does not spend or record
